inicio_texto: I study Multiplatform Application Development and build ERP software with Velneo during my internship. I finish in January 2027 and am looking for a junior developer role.
sobreMi_subtitulo: More about my background and approach to development
sobreMi_texto: Video games sparked my interest in programming. Today I apply that curiosity to a strategy game in Unity and to tools for sharing shopping lists and running a workshop.
sobrePro_texto: During my internship I develop ERP software with Velneo. I’m interested in how everyday business tasks translate into screens and data that a team can use.
habilidadesAptitudes_texto: Strong organization and planning skills, clear communication with the team, constant eagerness to learn, attention to detail, problem-solving, and quick adaptation to new work environments.
proyectos_subtitulo: A collection of applications, tools, and projects I've developed.
proyecto1_texto: End-of-course project in Java: a DragonQuest-style RPG with monsters, chests and a weapon system. Applies interfaces, inheritance and object-oriented programming.
proyecto2_texto: EA FC 26 player search tool built in JavaScript, with dynamic filtering by league and club, pagination, player detail view and favorites saved with localStorage.

carrera_practicas_texto: My internship runs until January 2027. I work with business processes, databases and ERP workflows.
contacto_disponible: My internship ends in January 2027 and I’m already looking for work. If you have an opening, I’d love to hear about your team and project.

proyecto_tallerMecanico: Workshop portal for vehicles and repair orders. Laravel serves customers, mechanics and administrators, and connects to Velneo through an API.

proyecto_atlas-de-aethria: Two-player turn-based strategy game for Windows with local play and peer-to-peer rooms.
proyecto_footballLeaugue: Web application for recording teams, players and results. Match results determine the league standings.
